title: The deploy pipeline can't reach this box over SSH on port 22
description_md:
An automated deploy pipeline connects to this box over SSH on port 22 as part of every release, and it's been failing all morning with a connection refused/timeout -- nothing answers on 22 at all. Someone changed something about how sshd listens. SSH in as `trainee` (passwordless `sudo`), figure out what port sshd is actually listening on now, and get it back to answering on port 22 (the pipeline can't be reconfigured today, so 22 has to work).

A test key is at `~/deploy_key`. You're done when `ssh -i ~/deploy_key -p 22 deploy@localhost 'echo SSH_OK'` prints `SSH_OK`.
